title: Churn-Aware Replication
tagline: Compares how four replication controllers trade write latency against long-term consistency under continuous node churn.

curves.label: Primary-Lease Replication
curves.code: for (let t=0;t<steps;t++){ let mu=churn[t]; cost=3+0.8*mu+0.05*mu*mu; series.push(cost);}
curves.name: Primary-Lease Replication

curves.label: Gossip with Anti-Entropy
curves.code: for(let t=0;t<steps;t++){let mu=churn[t]; let L=Math.log(1+mu); cost=2+0.6*mu+35*L*L+0.01*mu*mu; series.push(cost);}
curves.name: Gossip with Anti-Entropy

curves.label: Quorum Reconciliation
curves.code: for(let t=0;t<steps;t++){let mu=churn[t]; let L=Math.log(1+mu); cost=4+0.5*mu+2*mu*L+0.03*mu*mu; series.push(cost);}
curves.name: Quorum Reconciliation
